heading: Export a component
body:
List the component in `tac.elements` in `client/manifest.json`. Write its tag, as a page writes it: the folder `client/components/shop/counter` is `shop-counter`. `ty build` and `ty preview` then write `.tachyon/elements/shop-counter.js`, beside the runtime and the services that a Tac page already loads. A custom element is a tag that JavaScript defines, and the HTML standard says that its name must contain a hyphen. So a component in a folder with one part, such as `client/components/counter`, cannot be exported: the build stops with `TY1358`. `TY1358` also stops a name that is not a component (ADR 0086).

The element accepts a prop (a value that it receives) for each name that the template reads, except service names, loop names, `data` and `page`. It also accepts each field that a service needs with `@NeedsAll`. Here those props are `label` and `start`. When a service publishes an event, the element also sends it to the page as a DOM event. The event name is the model name in kebab case (words in small letters, joined by hyphens): `CountChanged` becomes `count-changed`. Choose JavaScript or TypeScript above the code.
